summary: MemoryMonitor samples every 1 second and writes to CSV on every sample — high-frequency disk I/O for diagnostics
detail: The .task in titleBar sleeps 1 second between recordSample calls. Each sample appends to ~/Library/Logs/Hootty/memory.csv. With 696 lines already written in ~30 minutes, this is writing to disk once per second indefinitely. Consider reducing frequency or only writing when delta exceeds a threshold.

summary: Task 4.5 (manual memory verification) could be partially automated with a test that creates/switches workspaces and asserts TerminalSurfaceView.liveCount vs occlusion call count
detail: The static liveCount property already tracks surface allocation. A similar static counter for occlusion state changes would let an integration test verify that switching workspaces triggers the expected number of set_occlusion calls without needing Activity Monitor.
